topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Unearthing a time capsule in my garden, a relic I cannot recall concealing, feels like confronting a puzzle crafted by a stranger. Each layer of soil peeled back, each grain sifted, reveals more than just the passage of years. It's a dialogue with the past, a monologue from a version of myself long forgotten. The contents—a tattered notebook, a cassette player, a handful of photographs—speak in whispers, hinting at a life once lived, a future once imagined. It’s as if the ground has opened to remind me of the complexity of memory and the narratives we build, only to lose track of them. The capsule is more than an object; it’s a bridge, connecting me to a self I never knew I left behind.
